Hi Priyom —

Great to hear from you. I attached our Vendor Request Form (Nimbus_Vendor_Request_Form.pdf). In short: we need the completed vendor form + a W-9 (for US entities) before we create a vendor ID and issue a PO. DocuSign is fine. Typical timeline after we receive a complete packet is 3-7 business days to create the vendor record and issue a PO. 

A few specifics for marketplace listings:
- For general purchases (direct invoicing): POs come from procurement@nimbushealth.com and are routed to your accounting email on file.
- For third-party marketplace purchases (AWS, GCP, Azure): we must capture the marketplace listing SKU and seller ID. For AWS Marketplace we treat the listing as a subscription and the billing may route through Marketplace billing; please share your AWS Seller ID if you have one.
- Payment terms: Net30 by default; expedited terms possible for enterprise agreements.

Please send the completed form and W-9 to procurement@nimbushealth.com (copy me) and include the billing contact and remit instructions.

Thanks,

Susan Kline
Sr. Procurement Manager
Nimbus Health

Attachment: Nimbus_Vendor_Request_Form.pdf
